estonia.title: Expert: Trump's recent decisions have nothing to do with midterms
estonia.description: Analyzing U.S. President Donald Trump's latest moves that have harmed Ukraine and favored Russia, U.S. politics expert Andreas Kaju admitted he could not explain why the president was making such decisions.

estonia.title: From spreadsheets to autonomous tractors: AI's growing role in farming
estonia.description: Artificial intelligence primarily helps farmers process data in their daily operations, but autonomous agricultural robots and drones are no longer the stuff of science fiction either.

estonia.title: People increasingly not paying hospital fees
estonia.description: Since patient visit fees increased last year, more and more people have been falling behind on payments to hospitals. Patients with outstanding debts can no longer see a specialist.

estonia.title: Reform Party unveils campaign slogan as PM touts economic growth
estonia.description: Prime Minister and Reform Party chair Kristen Michal says Estonia's economy is growing twice as fast as the EU average, as Reform pledges a clear course in the 2027 elections.

estonia.title: Gallery: Public bomb shelter in Tallinn hidden behind woodland mural
estonia.description: A street-level public civil defense shelter in the heart of downtown Tallinn has been transformed with a mural featuring Estonian trees and wildlife.

estonia.title: Nearly third of teachers at schools transitioning to Estonian unqualified
estonia.description: Nearly a third of teachers at schools transitioning to Estonian lack the required qualifications, as heavy workloads and limited pay make recruitment and retention harder.

estonia.title: Estonia's Eneli Jefimova sweeps skins event, snags MVP at college swim meet
estonia.description: Estonian swim star Eneli Jefimova swept the breaststroke skins event at California college meet Friday, snagging MVP honors, a personal best and a win for alma mater NC State.

estonia.title: Gallery: Central Estonia's upgraded Mäo junction reopens to traffic
estonia.description: Mäo's upgraded highway junction has reopened with five bus stops, two roundabouts and a 30-space parking lot, improving long-distance bus connections in Central Estonia.

estonia.title: Estonia, Latvia at odds over cross-border wind farm
estonia.description: A hybrid wind farm under construction in northern Latvia is stirring tensions across the border, where nearby Estonian villages are facing the greater impact.

estonia.title: Canceled school trips abroad leave dozens of families chasing refunds
estonia.description: Dozens of families in Estonia say they are out thousands of euros for canceled school language-learning trips abroad, with one organizer still owing about €50,000 in refunds.

estonia.title: Estonia's Soviet-era summer cottage culture to become museum exhibit
estonia.description: Estonian researchers are mapping the country's fading garden-cottage heritage — the suvila built across the Soviet era.

estonia.title: Wind farm bonus unconstitutional, NGO says as ministry pushes plan
estonia.description: An NGO says a planned bonus to for local governments for developing wind-farms within their jurisdictions is unconstitutional.

estonia.title: Pärnu to swap public recycling for curbside pickup in 2027
estonia.description: Pärnu is switching to curbside pickup for sorted household waste in 2027, eliminating public paper and recycling dumpsters from across the city.

estonia.title: Bedroom window requirement upheld by justice chancellor
estonia.description: Estonia's justice chancellor has found that requiring bedrooms to have openable windows and natural light is constitutional, even in homes with mechanical ventilation.

estonia.title: Estonian players have mixed fortunes in UEFA Conference League clashes
estonia.description: Estonian center-back Maksim Paskotši played a full match in his Belgian team's Conference League win Thursday.

estonia.title: MP: Eesti 200 should 'lick its wounds' and sit out 2027 elections
estonia.description: Eesti 200 MPs Ando Kiviberg and Toomas Uibo say their struggling coalition party should skip next March's Riigikogu elections and instead focus on rebuilding for 2031.

estonia.title: Defense official: Front heats up, energy truce fails as US-Kyiv strain grows
estonia.description: The recent US–Russia diesel deal and a failed energy truce have strained ties with Kyiv at a time when fighting has been escalating at the front, the defense ministry said.

estonia.title: Pärnu named European City of Sport for 2027
estonia.description: Pärnu has been awarded the European City of Sport 2027 title by the European Capitals and Cities of Sport Federation, the city announced.

estonia.title: Estonia wants to block Russian gas transit through Baltics for good
estonia.description: Energy minister Erkki Keldo (Reform) wants to work with Latvia to permanently stop Russian gas transit through the Baltics, with other options on the table if talks fail.

estonia.title: Expert: Trump does not have the power to force Ukraine to capitulate
estonia.description: While Donald Trump's unpredictable behavior and disruptions to Starlink are complicating the situation in Ukraine, the U.S. president does not have the power to force Ukraine to surrender, security expert Ilmar Raag finds.

estonia.title: Platform workers' grueling hours raising health and safety concerns
estonia.description: Many food couriers and ride-hailing drivers in Estonia work exhausting hours that put their health and road safety at risk, but the government has no plans to intervene.

estonia.title: Experts: French grocery store cyberattack a warning sign for Estonia
estonia.description: A cyberattack on French grocery stores Sunday that resulted in large quantities of food being destroyed is also a warning sign for Estonia, cybersecurity experts say.

estonia.title: Estonia gets €32m EU funding for 'free world's first line of defense' surveillance
estonia.description: The European Commission has given preliminary approval for nearly €32 million toward Estonia's eastern border drone surveillance system, a project already partly built.

estonia.title: Ralf Tribuntsov takes third at World Cup, sets Estonian record
estonia.description: Swimmer Ralf Tribuntsov set a new domestic record in the 100-meter backstroke at the World Cup stage in Astana, Kazakhstan, finishing third in 49.88 seconds.

estonia.title: Museums fear research funding shuffle threatens key projects
estonia.description: Museums are concerned that the loss of research funding will jeopardize their projects and hope the decision will be reversed.

estonia.title: Estonia plans to bring back its blue passports from 2030
estonia.description: The Interior Ministry plans to redesign Estonian passports and add new security features, with blue covers returning for citizen passports from 2030.

estonia.title: China protests Estonian politicians attending a Taiwanese event in Tallinn
estonia.description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Estonia submitted a formal diplomatic note to the Riigikogu over lawmakers' attendance at an event celebrating Taiwan's National Day in Tallinn.

estonia.title: New support measures to boost tourism beyond Tallinn
estonia.description: The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to provide grants to regional tourism organizations to encourage tourists to visit parts of Estonia outside Tallinn.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 16. oktoobril
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Estonia's €50m planned island e-ferry passes first model tests with flying colors
estonia.description: A scale model of Estonia's planned €49.93 million electric ferry has passed its first tests in Germany, reaching 14 knots where the contract requires 12.

estonia.title: Elisa to shut down 2G network in 2028, competitors hold back for now
estonia.description: Phone operator Elisa is to shut down its 2G mobile network in 2028, Sakala reported.

estonia.title: Estonia mulls allowing dual citizenship in certain circumstances
estonia.description: The coalition parties want to allow Estonian citizens by birth to hold dual citizenship. The opposition questions what problem the change is intended to solve.

estonia.title: Estonian ex-soldier jailed in Russia after visiting his wife
estonia.description: A former Estonian Defense Forces member is currently in a Russian prison, accused by the FSB of planning to fight for Ukraine — a charge his family says was forced out of him.

estonia.title: Tartu prison director: Dissatisfaction with prison life hardly out of the ordinary
estonia.description: Tartu Prison Director Merle Ulst acknowledged that renting out prison space is a new situation for all parties involved, requiring both the Estonian Prison Service and the inmates brought to Estonia to adapt.

estonia.title: Eesti 200 to decide Sunday on running with Greens at Riigikogu election
estonia.description: Eesti 200 chair Kristina Kallas is to propose at Sunday's party board meeting that the party run alongside the Greens in the March 2027 Riigikogu elections.

estonia.title: Foreign minister: One must ensure one's own survival when inflicting pain on Russia
estonia.description: Estonia's decision to keep a Russian supplier to Silmet off the EU sanctions list was necessary to protect European industry, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said, but stressed that the company must end its dependence on Russian raw materials or face further sanctions.

estonia.title: Estonia still importing Russian food products
estonia.description: Estonia's trade with Russia has dwindled since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, but imports of food products have continued alongside rare earth metals.

estonia.title: Company managing Narva border queue asks city for support after traffic dries up
estonia.description: Cross-border vehicle traffic has come to a standstill and the city-owned company is struggling to make ends meet. City officials have not ruled out suspending the company's operations.

estonia.title: Major investment to take Skeleton's valuation over €1 billion
estonia.description: German technology group Siemens is investing at least €100 million in Estonian company Skeleton Technologies, raising its valuation to €1 billion.

estonia.title: Ida-Viru County's only psychiatric hospital closes doors
estonia.description: Ida-Viru County's only psychiatric hospital specializing in mental health treatment is closing due to a shortage of specialists.

estonia.title: Tallinn tram driver: TLT doesn't train staff enough or review incidents
estonia.description: A Tallinn tram department employee says drivers aren't given enough training or information about serious incidents, contradicting the transport company's public position.

estonia.title: European Prosecutor's Office will not keep Estonia in the loop in Datasel proceedings
estonia.description: The European Public Prosecutor's Office said it would not comment on the ongoing investigation involving Datasel to the Riigikogu's Anti-Corruption Select Committee.

estonia.title: Estonia would allow criminal proceeds to be confiscated without a conviction
estonia.description: Estonia plans to work with other European Union countries to amend legislation to allow assets obtained through criminal activity to be confiscated even without a criminal conviction.

estonia.title: Ministry of Culture drops plan to slash county library funding
estonia.description: Minister of Culture Heidy Purga told Kuku Radio that a previously planned cut in state funding for public libraries next year has now been scrapped.

estonia.title: Photos: Ülle Madise meets Alexander Stubb in Helsinki on 2nd foreign trip
estonia.description: Newly inaugurated Estonian President Ülle Madise met Finnish President Alexander Stubb in Helsinki on Wednesday to discuss European security and Nordic-Baltic cooperation.

estonia.title: Tallinn French Lyceum struggling with leaky sports hall roof
estonia.description: The Tallinn French Lyceum's sports hall began leaking even before it opened, but the leak has now become so severe that the school has suspended use of the building for several days.

estonia.title: Estonian parliament supports lower voting age at European Parliament elections
estonia.description: The Riigikogu has passed a law allowing young people to vote in European Parliament elections from the age of 16 and stand as candidates from the age of 18, starting in 2029.

estonia.title: Watch again: XXIX Open Society Forum on democratic renewal
estonia.description: The XXIX Open Society Forum took place October 15 at the Nordic Hotel Forum in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Tallinn food bank takes on 43,000 canned wild boar from state after ASF cull
estonia.description: The state handed over more than 43,776 canned wild boar to a food bank this week, to be distributed to those in need, Maaleht reported.

estonia.title: Estonia's EE-ALARM test sets SMS record but sheltering gaps remain
estonia.description: The Rescue Board tested the nationwide EE-ALARM warning system again on Wednesday, setting a delivery record but finding many residents still don't know what the sirens mean.

estonia.title: Sõida hoopis siia! Lõuna-Itaalia saladus, mis teeb silmad ette Amalfile ja on poole soodsam
estonia.description: Kui mõelda unistuste puhkusele Itaalias, tulevad sageli silme ette Amalfi ranniku järsud kaljud, tsitrusesalud ja mäekülgedel asuvad erksavärvilised linnakesed. Kuigi Amalfi on vaieldamatult kaunis, kaasnevad selle tuntusega tihtipeale tohutud turistide hordid, ülikõrged hinnad ja keeruline liikumine. Kuid Itaalia saapakontsas peidab end piirkond, mis pakub vähemalt sama lummavat Vahemere hõngu, kuid märksa rahulikumal ja taskukohasemal moel – selleks on Apuulia (tuntud ka kui Puglia).

estonia.title: Need ohumärgid annavad signaali, et vananed oodatust kiiremini
estonia.description: Mõni 90-aastane on vaimselt terav kui ämblik, loeb põnevusega raamatuid ja võidab lapselapsi sõnamängudes, samal ajal kui poole noorem inimene ei suuda meenutada, kuhu ta autovõtmed pani. Teadus kinnitab, et meie aju võib vananeda täiesti teises tempos kui meie passi kantud sünniaasta.

estonia.title: KUHU JÄID FÄNNID? ⟩ Eesti räpimaailma suurnimede kontserdil haigutas publiku seas tühjus: sai vabalt esireas nautida!
estonia.description: Laupäeval, 17. oktoobril astusid Tallinna ööklubis Privé lavale Beebilõust, Genka, Pluuto ja OKYM. Kuigi ühe õhtu jooksul sai kuulda nelja tuntud Eesti räpparit ja pilet maksis vaid kümme eurot, avanes kohaletulnutele üllatav vaatepilt. «Olime enam-vähem esimesed!» meenutas üks kontserdikülastaja, kelle sõnul oli rahvast kohal ootamatult vähe.

estonia.title: OTSELEKANNE ⟩ Terminal Lõuna-Eesti Rahvaliiga pühapäevane mängupäev
estonia.description: Lõuna-Eesti korvpalli Rahvaliiga jätkub pühapäeval nelja kohtumisega Melliste Spordihoones. Postimees näitab kohtumisi otsepildis.

estonia.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Ukraina tegi sõja suurima õhurünnaku Peterburile
estonia.description: Ukraina president teatas, et Venemaa kavatseb paigutada Valgevene territooriumile ballistiliste rakettide laskeseadmed, et ulatuda tabama nende rakettidega Ukraina läänepoolseid piirkondi. Ukraina president kinnitas, et praegu paiknevad Valgevenes raadiosaatjad, mille abil juhitakse droonide rünnakuid Ukraina läänepoolsetele linnadele, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

estonia.title: Avastati veel üks teemandi struktuuridest – hõreteemant
estonia.description: Teemandil ja grafiidil on uus sugulane nimega hõreteemant ehk teemantdiüün (diamondiyne), mille kristallstruktuur on seni kinnitust leidnud vaid mikroskoopilistel laikudel.

estonia.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Ukraina ajaloolane 1700. sõjapäeva puhul: Zelenskõi radikaliseerub, valmis minema va banque
estonia.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi muutub järjest radikaalsemaks, mida on näha tema sõnasõjast USA presidendi Donald Trumpiga ja mis võib Ukrainale olla väga ohtlik, ütles sõja 1700. päevale pühendatud intervjuus üks Ukraina tuntumaid ajaloolasi ja mõtlejaid, Lvivis asuva Ukraina katoliku ülikooli professor Jaroslav Hrõtsak. Ukraina täiemahulise sõja 1700. päev täitub teisipäeval.

estonia.title: Jose Mourinho tegi Reali staarmängija kohta ootamatu avalduse. «Ta oleks pidanud klubist lahkuma.»
estonia.description: Madridi Reali jalgpalliklubi peatreener Jose Mourinho teatas, et meeskonna superstaar Vinicius Junior oleks pidanud suvel klubist lahkuma.

estonia.title: FOTOD JA VIDEO ⟩ Pariisi rahutuste keskele sattunud eestlanna kirjeldab hirmutavat ööd: see vaatepilt oli ikka täiesti ulmeline!
estonia.description: Pariisi Céline Dioni kontserti nautima sõitnud eestlanna Merike Paasalu ja tema abikaasa ei osanud aimatagi, milline vaatepilt neid pärast võimsat muusikaelamust ees ootab. Öösel tuli paaril liikuda läbi lõhutud tänavate, kus ringi liikunud noortekambad tekitasid neis tõsist kõhedust. «Mina hoidsin samal ajal lausa kramplikult oma käekotist kinni,» meenutab Paasalu Elu24-le. See polnud aga esimene kord, kui abielupaar Prantsusmaal ohtlike sündmuste lähedusse sattus, sest kümme aastat tagasi viibisid nad Nizzas terrorirünnaku ajal.

estonia.title: HEIKI PÄRDI ⟩ Risti – kas ilusaim alevik Läänemaal?
estonia.description: Ilusaim Läänemaa alevik – niisuguse hellitusnimega ristisid kohalikud Läänemaa ajakirjanikud Ristit 1930. aastate algul. Risti on kujunenud kunagise Koluvere mõisa maadele. Aleviku alal oli neli talu, millest on säilinud ainult üks: aleviku keskosas asuv Siima.

estonia.title: Nõelamaalid Kondase keskuses. Tikkimine on kodune vabadusesaar!
estonia.description: Pöörane ja peen! Vahest võiks nii iseloomustada Kondase keskust vallutanud tikandinäitust. Eriti pädeb see Saaremaalt pärit Maria Peedi (1913–2002) kohta, kelle loomingu totaalsus avaneb eriti suurejooneliselt.

estonia.title: Europarlamendi naissaadikuid kimbutavad süvavõltsitud alastifotod
estonia.description: Austria roheliste partei esindaja Lena Schilling on üks viiekümnest eurosaadikust, kellest on loodud seksuaalse alatooniga süvavõltsinguid.

estonia.title: Hinnateadlikud eestlased jätavad säästuvõimalused sageli kasutamata
estonia.description: Eestlased on hinnateadlikud ja oma igakuiste kuludega hästi kursis, kuid Norstati uuringust selgus, et turul valitseb paradoksaalne trend: rohkem kui kolmandik tarbijaid tunnetab, et maksab igakuiselt mobiilsideteenuste eest liiga kõrget hinda. Sellegipoolest pole valdav enamik inimesi teenusepakkujat aastaid või mitte kunagi vahetanud.

estonia.title: Tallinnas põrkasid kokku kaks autot, üks juht viidi haiglasse
estonia.description: Tallinnas Kristiine linnaosas toimus pühapäeva hommikul liiklusõnnetus, mille tagajärjel viidi üks autojuhtidest haiglasse kontrolli.

estonia.title: FOTOD ⟩ Kahe auto kokkupõrge Sõpruse puiesteel: üks juht viidi haiglasse
estonia.description: Täna ennelõunal juhtus Tallinnas Sõpruse puiestee ja Koskla tänava ristmikul mitme auto osalusel liiklusõnnetus, sündmuskohale saabusid politsei, päästjad ja kiirabi.

latvia.title: A harmadik világháborúra utaló jeleket sorolta fel a Financial Times
latvia.description: A lap szerint Vlagyimir Putyin napjainkban azt latolgatja, többet jelent-e a NATO 5-ös paragrafusa egy papírfecninél.

latvia.title: Dróntámadás érte Szentpétervárt: kigyulladt a hatalmas olajterminál, ezrek maradtak áram nélkül - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index vasárnapi hírösszefoglalója
latvia.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index vasárnapi hírösszefoglalója.

latvia.title: Renátó visszanézte a Házasság első látásrát: „Csak ámulok és bámulok, micsoda hazugsághálókra derült így utólag fény”
Lezárták Moszkva légterét, Trump kihátrált a kemény szankciók mögül – Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról szombaton
latvia.description: Donald Trump egy pénteken kiadott rendeletével felfüggesztette az oroszellenes szankciós törvény kulcsfontosságú rendelkezéseit – köztük az orosz árukra kivetendő vámokat és az orosz olaj- és gázvásárlásokat büntető intézkedéseket –, mindössze néhány nappal a hatálybalépésük előtt. Ukrajna közben újraindította az orosz olajfinomítók elleni csapásokat: már hatodik egymást követő éjszaka korlátozták a légiforgalmat Moszkva felett, a fővárosi repülőtereken járatok százai torlódtak fel. A Fekete-tenger térségében kereskedelmi hajókat érnek dróncsapások, Nicușor Dan román elnök ezért a NATO nagyobb szerepvállalását kéri a térségben. A fronton az orosz vezérkar a Donyeck megyei erődváros, Dobropillja elfoglalásáról számolt be, Moszkva szerint pedig egyelőre nincs napirenden a béketárgyalások folytatása az amerikai küldöttséggel. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb fejleményeivel.

latvia.title: Magyar Péter elárulta, mit kért tőle Zelenszkij a négyszemközti tárgyalásuk során
latvia.description: Történelmi jelentőségűnek nevezte Magyar Péter miniszterelnök a kárpátaljai magyarok jogairól kötött megállapodást, miután négyszemközt tárgyalt Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnökkel. A kormányfő az RTL-nek adott interjújában jó kezdetnek nevezte a megállapodást, amely szerinte javíthatja a két ország kapcsolatát, ugyanakkor jelezte, hogy a következő hetekben figyelni fogják, teljesül-e a többi része is. Zelenszkij kérésére Magyar Péter azt mondta, nincs akadálya annak, hogy az ukrán kukoricát vonaton Magyarországon keresztül szállítsák Nyugat-Európába, amennyiben a szállítmányok csak áthaladnak az országon. Az ukrán elnök október 23-i budapesti látogatását nem tartja valószínűnek, bár az állami megemlékezésre több uniós vezető, köztük Emmanuel Macron francia elnök is érkezik.

latvia.title: A folyamatos dróntámadások miatt a NATO segítségét kéri a román elnök
latvia.description: Nicușor Dan román elnök a Fekete-tenger biztonságáról és a NATO szerepvállalásáról beszélt az euronewsnak adott interjújában, miközben kereskedelmi hajókat érnek dróncsapások Románia és Bulgária partjainál, a térség biztonsági helyzete pedig egyre feszültebbé válik.

latvia.title: Poland and Norway sign declaration on deepening security ties
latvia.description: The plans include joint defence production, strengthening NATO's northern and eastern flanks, and continued support for Ukraine.

latvia.title: Rubio o systemie satelitarnym. "Teraz nie jest dostępny dla Ukrainy"
latvia.description: Marco Rubio zaprzeczył, by administracja Donalda Trumpa odpowiadała za spowolnienie łączności satelitarnej używanej przez ukraińskie wojsko. Według sekretarza stanu USA Ukraina nie ma obecnie dostępu do wojskowej wersji systemu - Starshield.

latvia.title: Litovčania išli do úkrytov pre neznámy objekt vo vzduchu
latvia.description: Litva vyhlásila červené letecké varovanie pre neznámy objekt. Do vzduchu vzlietli stíhačky NATO a úrady pátrajú po možných troskách dronu.

latvia.title: Senátor ODS podpořil v Plzni sokyni z ANO. Skončilo to vítězstvím opozice a nejvyšší volební účastí
latvia.description: Málokterý senátní souboj byl tak sledovaný jako ten v okrsku Plzeň-město. Zasloužil se o to neúspěšný kandidát Lumír Aschenbrenner (ODS), který v týdnu překvapivě podpořil Lucii Kantorovou z vládního ANO. Ta ve druhém kole soupeřila s někdejším šéfem generálního štábu Karlem Řehkou kandidujícím za opoziční STAN. Výsledek? Mobilizace voličů a drtivé vítězství Řehky.

latvia.title: AI jako výbušné i hravé téma. Byla jsem na londýnské premiéře filmu Artificial
latvia.description: Davy, kam se podíváš. Stojí před londýnským kinem Royal Festival Hall. Čekají na tvůrce filmu Artificial. Natočil ho režisér Luca Guadagnino. A mluví se o něm opravdu hodně, nejen kvůli tématu, ale také kvůli možné cenzuře a výkonu Andrewa Garfielda, jenž hraje Sama Altmana, tedy tvář vývoje AI. Mám to štěstí, že jsem byla na evropské premiéře.

latvia.title: Kanaďan se po 51 letech setkal s peněženkou a doklady, které ztratil jako brigádník na stavbě domu
latvia.description: Osmašedesátiletý muž se po 51 letech setkal se svou peněženkou, kterou ztratil jako brigádník na stavbě jednoho domu v Dartmouthu v kanadské provincii Nové Skotsko. Náhodou ji pod starou podlahou objevil řemeslník, jenž nyní stavení rekonstruoval. Majitele dohledal s pomocí příspěvku na Facebooku.

latvia.title: Ce va însemna diagnosticul de cancer pulmonar al papei Leon pentru pontificatul său: umil, răbdător și deschis
latvia.description: Atenția intensă acordată diagnosticului de cancer pulmonar al papei Leon al XIV-lea este inevitabilă, având în vedere că pontiful american este monarhul de facto al unui stat, chiar dacă acesta este minuscul, și liderul spiritual a peste 1,4 miliarde de catolici. Tratamentul adenocarcinomului său a decurs fără probleme, dar prelații intriganți ar putea să se năpustească asupra reformelor lui Leon, dacă starea sa de sănătate continuă să se deterioreze, scrie The Times într-o analiză a posibilelor efecte pe care cancerul le poate avea asupra mandatului lui Leon al XIV-lea în fruntea Bisericii Catolice.

latvia.title: Povestea singurului producător de clopote de biserică din Liban: „Trebuie să le transmitem tradiția copiilor, au trecut 300 de ani”
latvia.description: Povestea ultimului meșter de clopote de biserică din Liban începe cu o pușcă. În secolul al XVIII-lea, Youssef Gabriel, un fierar local, fabrica în secret puști și îi înarma pe revoluționarii arabi pentru a-i sprijini în revolta lor împotriva Imperiului Otoman, care controla Libanul la acea vreme. Apoi, într-o zi, un inginer rus a venit în satul libanez Beit Chabab pentru a confecționa un clopot de biserică. Gabriel, intrigat, l-a urmărit pe bărbat și a învățat imediat procesul, relatează The Guardian.

latvia.title: Reuniune a Consiliului NATO, programată la cererea României, după atacurile navelor la Marea Neagră și incursiunile dronelor rusești
latvia.description: Aliații NATO se reunesc marți, în ședință, pentru a discuta situația tensionată de la Marea Neagră. O reuniune a Consiliului Nord-Atlantic a fost programată la inițiativa României. Pericolul dronelor Rusiei nu planează doar asupra Alianței, ci și a Republicii Moldova.

latvia.title: Trupele NATO se vor antrena în Polonia în vederea unor posibile misiuni de menținere a păcii în Ucraina
latvia.description: Cel puțin 1.500 de militari din Marea Britanie, Franța și Germania urmează să exerseze operațiunile logistice și de coordonare, în pregătirea unei posibile desfășurări viitoare în Ucraina.

latvia.title: Paleontologii au descoperit o pasăre din Jurasic care semăna cu un fazan carnivor și avea gheare mortale. De ce nu putea zbura
latvia.description: O pasăre primitivă, descoperită în China, avea un amestec neobișnuit de trăsături de pasăre și dinozaur, iar anatomia sa sugerează că era un prădător terestru, adaptat pentru alergare și dotat cu gheare puternice, notează Live Science. Descoperirea arată că primele păsări aveau o diversitate mai mare de forme și moduri de viață decât se credea anterior.

latvia.title: Reacția Rusiei după ce Donald Trump a decis suspendarea Legii Graham și a sancțiunilor legate de vânzări rusești de combustibili
latvia.description: Suspendarea legii care instituie noi sancţiuni împotriva Rusiei, iniţiată de fostul senator Lindsey Graham, reprezintă un moment istoric, a declarat Kirill Dmitriev, reprezentantul special al preşedintelui rus pentru investiţii şi cooperare economică cu ţările străine şi directorul Fondului Rus de Investiţii Directe, relatează TASS.

latvia.title: Inspectorul General al Pentagonului, chemat de senatori să ancheteze întreruperea funcționării sistemelor Starshield pentru Ucraina
latvia.description: În această săptămână, senatorii Thom Tillis (Republican) și Jeanne Shaheen (Democrat), copreședinții Grupului de Observatori ai Senatului pentru NATO (SNOG), au condus un grup bipartizan format din șapte senatori care a adresat o scrisoare inspectorului general al Departamentului Apărării, Platte B. Moring III, solicitând o anchetă cu privire la întreruperea funcționării sistemelor Starshield întreținute de SUA pentru partenerii ucraineni, scrie The Hills.

latvia.title: Apărarea României la Marea Neagră, în discuțiile cu aliații. Nicușor Dan anunță sprijinul Franței
latvia.description: Nicușor Dan a prezentat vineri concluziile Consiliului European de toamnă, un summit cu mai multe mize, în special negocierile privind bugetul multianual al UE pentru perioada 2028-2034. Președintele a anunțat că Franța a răspuns în 24 de ore solicitării României de sprijin pentru consolidarea securității la Marea Neagră, până la sosirea echipamentelor militare comandate prin programul SAFE. Șeful statului a precizat că a discutat despre situația din regiune cu secretarul general al NATO, cu președintele francez și cu premierii Bulgariei și Greciei.

latvia.title: Rusia pune la îndoială dezminţirea NATO privind planurile de blocare a enclavei Kaliningrad și amenință: „Războiul va fi scurt”
latvia.description: Rusia a pus sub semnul întrebării vineri declaraţiile unor reprezentanţi ai NATO care dezmint că Alianţa plănuieşte să blocheze enclava rusă Kaliningrad, situată între Lituania şi Polonia, informează EFE.

latvia.title: Primul deputat PNL care anunță că nu votează Guvernul Niculescu: Vom ajunge într-o situație mai rea. PSD să își găsească susținători
latvia.description: Deputatul PNL Dragoș Ciobotaru, liderul filialei liberale din Vrancea, a anunțat că nu va vota Guvernul condus de premierul desemnat Luca Niculescu. El susține că PSD, partidul pe care îl consideră responsabil pentru căderea Guvernului Ilie Bolojan, trebuie să își asume formarea unui nou Executiv, fără să transfere această responsabilitate liberalilor.

latvia.title: Ce priorități de politică externă are Guvernul propus de Luca Niculescu. Care vor fi relațiile cu UE, cu NATO și cu SUA
latvia.description: Programul de guvernare propus de Luca Niculescu cuprinde și prioritățile României pe politică externă și afaceri europene, fiind structurat în patru capitole mari: „România în Uniunea Europeană și în OCDE”, „Securitate: NATO, SUA, Marea Neagră și vecinătatea”, „Diplomație Economică și parteneriate globale”, și „Cetățeni, diaspora și o diplomație profesionistă”.

latvia.title: Cod roșu aerian în Lituania după detectarea unui obiect zburător: Aeroport închis și populație trimisă în adăposturi / Alte două țări sunt și ele în alertă
latvia.description: Un obiect zburător neidentificat a declanșat o alertă de cod roșu în Lituania, în timp ce Polonia verifică o posibilă încălcare a spațiului aerian. Avioanele NATO au fost trimise să intervină. Armata și Centrul Național de Gestionare a Crizelor au cerut, duminică dimineață, locuitorilor din centrul și nordul Lituaniei să se adăpostească timp de o …

latvia.title: Autoritățile vor notifica cetățenii înainte de expirarea actelor. Senatul a adoptat un proiect USR, urmează votul decisiv din Camera Deputaților
latvia.description: Senatul a adoptat săptămâna trecută inițiativa senatoarei USR Violeta Alexandru care introduce în Codul administrativ obligația de notificare electronică a titularilor actelor administrative individuale – permise, certificate, autorizații etc. – cu cel puțin 30 de zile înainte de expirarea acestora, potrivit unui comunicat. Urmează dezbaterile și votul din Camera Deputaților, camera decizională. Proiectul vrea să […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Estonia, Latvia at odds over cross-border wind farm
latvia.description: A hybrid wind farm under construction in northern Latvia is stirring tensions across the border, where nearby Estonian villages are facing the greater impact.

latvia.title: Estonia wants to block Russian gas transit through Baltics for good
latvia.description: Energy minister Erkki Keldo (Reform) wants to work with Latvia to permanently stop Russian gas transit through the Baltics, with other options on the table if talks fail.

latvia.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Ukraina tegi sõja suurima õhurünnaku Peterburile
latvia.description: Ukraina president teatas, et Venemaa kavatseb paigutada Valgevene territooriumile ballistiliste rakettide laskeseadmed, et ulatuda tabama nende rakettidega Ukraina läänepoolseid piirkondi. Ukraina president kinnitas, et praegu paiknevad Valgevenes raadiosaatjad, mille abil juhitakse droonide rünnakuid Ukraina läänepoolsetele linnadele, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

latvia.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Ukraina ajaloolane 1700. sõjapäeva puhul: Zelenskõi radikaliseerub, valmis minema va banque
latvia.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi muutub järjest radikaalsemaks, mida on näha tema sõnasõjast USA presidendi Donald Trumpiga ja mis võib Ukrainale olla väga ohtlik, ütles sõja 1700. päevale pühendatud intervjuus üks Ukraina tuntumaid ajaloolasi ja mõtlejaid, Lvivis asuva Ukraina katoliku ülikooli professor Jaroslav Hrõtsak. Ukraina täiemahulise sõja 1700. päev täitub teisipäeval.

latvia.description: LSM was recently in Liepāja for the announcement of the city's programme during its time as a European Capital of Culture for 2027, as you may have already read.

latvia.title: Latvia's independence-era allies remembered
latvia.description: On Friday, October 16, a memorial event was held at the Naval Patrol Ship Squadron in Daugavgrīva, honouring the British, French, and Irish sailors who fell while supporting Latvia during the War of Independence in 1919.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Riga IFF, Magic, Rock
latvia.description: Another weekend is here! A few tips on how to spend it.

latvia.title: Another aid convoy on its way from Latvia to Ukraine
latvia.description: October 16th saw the departure of yet another aid shipment organized by the volunteer organization “Entrepreneurs for Peace” (Uzņēmēji mieram).

latvia.title: Baltic Assembly to meet in Tallinn
latvia.description: The Baltic Assembly will discuss security of the Baltic States and strengthening defence cooperation when members and Speakers of the Parliaments and representatives of the governments of the Baltic States will gather in Tallinn, Estonia, for the 45th Session of the Baltic Assembly and the 32nd Baltic Council.

latvia.title: Latvia's 'Home Café Days' were a big hit again
latvia.description: From July 4 to September 13, the Home Café Days in Latvia proved more popular than ever, according to the Latvian Investment and Development Agency (LIAA).

latvia.title: Election results confirmed in Latvia
latvia.description: At its meeting on Friday, the Central Election Commission (CEC) confirmed the official results of the 15th Saeima elections and the list of elected MPs.

latvia.title: 264 million euro contract signed for Rīga Airport rail link
latvia.description: In order to create a new railway connection between RIX Riga Airport and Riga Central Railway Station, which will serve as a section of Rail Baltica in the future, “Latvijas dzelzceļš” (Latvian Railways/LDz) has signed an agreement with the Central Finance and Contracts Agency on the implementation of a European Union funds project, a release said on October 16th.

latvia.title: Latvia's National Guards drilling this weekend
latvia.description: From October 16th to 18th, planned military exercises of the 19th Combat Support Battalion of the 1st Riga Brigade of the National Guard will take place in Ropaži and Bauska regions.

latvia.title: Latvia's 'tourism intensity' is low by EU standards
latvia.description: In 2025, the EU recorded 3.1 billion nights spent in tourist accommodation establishments, up from 3.0 billion in 2024 (+4.1%). Domestic and international tourists accounted for almost equal numbers of nights. Compared with 2015, nights spent in EU tourist accommodations increased by 26.5%, from 2.5 billion.

latvia.title: Latvian Television's morning newscast had technical issues Friday
latvia.description: On the morning of Friday, 16 October, the broadcast of “Rīta panorāma”, the regular weekday morning programme on Latvian public media's television channel, was delayed by just under an hour due to technical issues, according to Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Illegal fishing uncovered near Salacgrīva, Latvia
latvia.description: Inspectors from the State Environmental Service (VVD) removed 14 illegally set fishing nets, with a total length of 1,230 metres, from the coastal waters of the Gulf of Riga in Salacgrīva parish, the VVD said.

latvia.title: Court rules gambling location ban in Daugavpils constitutional
latvia.description: The Constitutional Court has ruled that the ban imposed by Daugavpils local authority on organising gambling in the vicinity of certain buildings is in accordance with the Constitution, the court announced on October 16.

latvia.title: VID: There will be no Russian diesel going through Latvia's ports
latvia.description: The US decision to ease sanctions on Russian diesel fuel trade has no direct impact in Latvia. Although the agreement between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin allows additional supplies of Russian diesel to enter the global market, such shipments are not permitted to pass through Latvian ports, as confirmed to Latvian Television by the State Revenue Service.

latvia.title: Drivers' diligence tested in 'white cane' campaign in Latvia
latvia.description: The white cane ensures the safety of blind people on the streets, but unfortunately, simply raising it does not mean that all drivers will be prepared to stop. On Thursday, International White Cane Day, a test was carried out in Liepāja to see how attentive drivers are and whether they know what to do when they encounter a blind pedestrian, TV Kurzeme reported.

latvia.title: Former Daugavpils mayor says he's ready for jail time
latvia.description: "Prison is not the worst place. People live there. I am ready for it, I am ready to serve my sentence there," former Daugavpils mayor Rihards Eigims said about his upcoming prison sentence on the LSM Latgale editorial programme "Vietējais jautājums" ("Local question").

latvia.title: Allegations of emotional abuse regarding MP Judins
latvia.description: Andrejs Judins, Chair of the Saeima Legal Affairs Committee and a member of the “New Unity” party, has come under fire for alleged emotional abuse of a committee staff member, Latvian Radio reported on October 14.

latvia.title: Sanctions conference in Rīga will discuss 'Degrading Russia’s War Machine'
latvia.description: The Financial Intelligence Unit of Latvia (FIU Latvia) is inviting the public to watch the livestream of its 8th annual international sanctions conference “Sanctions Work: Degrading Russia’s War Machine” online on 12th November, starting at 10:00 (Rīga time).

latvia.title: Nearly half of Latvian homes still uninsured
latvia.description: The share of insured residential properties in Latvia has increased from 30.8% to 52.8% over eight years. This means that slightly more than half of residential properties in Latvia are currently insured according to a home insurance market assessment conducted by Latvijas Banka (the Latvian central bank).

latvia.title: Saeima supports stiffer penalties for aiding illegal migration
latvia.description: In order to strengthen criminal liability for organizing illegal migration and other violations related to the illegal movement and residence of persons, the Saeima adopted urgent amendments to the Criminal Law on Thursday, October 15th.

latvia.title: Weapons thieves arrested getting some fast food in Daugavpils, Latvia
latvia.description: Shortly after stealing two firearms from a range in Daugavpils, the thieves were apprehended at a fast-food restaurant in Daugavpils and taken into custody, according to the State Police.

latvia.title: Indian scientist and Ukrainian athlete given Latvian citizenship by Saeima
latvia.description: On Thursday, October 15th, Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, granted Latvian citizenship to Ukrainian athlete Danylo Michuda and Indian scientist Divya Kannan Vishwanath.

latvia.title: Baiba Zūzena: Saeima could stop the creation of unified public media
latvia.description: The amendments to the law, upon which the Saeima will vote on Thursday, October 15th, could effectively halt the further creation of a unified Latvian Public Media (LSM), rather than protecting the historical brand names of Latvian Radio and Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia is not particularly EEE-wasteful
latvia.description: In 2024, 12.3 kg of electrical and electronic equipment waste (WEEE or e-waste) per person was collected in the European Union, according to fresh Eurostat data.

latvia.title: State Language Day marked in Latvia
latvia.description: The Latvian language is the foundation of the Latvian state, said Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs in an address on State Language Day on 15 October.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Learning to Care: Education and Training in Culture and Health conference
latvia.description: Thursday, October 15th sees Rīga hosting an important international conference titled Learning to Care: Education and Training in Culture and Health, as we previously reported.

latvia.title: Rīga Central Station square to be redeveloped
latvia.description: The proposal ‘Migla’, submitted by the architectural practice SIA ‘NOONSOON’ and the landscape architecture practice SIA ‘Nemoralis’, has been recognised as the best entry in the design competition for the development of Central Station Square in Rīga, according to information on the tender website.

latvia.description: The Saeima elections of October 3rd were flagged up in advance as the most important for a long time – but in the end only the narrowest majority of the electorate bothered to vote: 51%.

latvia.title: How making a sandwich in wartime was an ideological act
latvia.description: Examining an interesting slice of history, Latvian Radio reports on the art of butter-free sandwiches and other examples of wartime rationing.

latvia.title: Stamp to honour Latvian sculptor Teodors Zaļkalns
latvia.description: To mark the 150th anniversary of Teodors Zaļkalns, the founder of Latvian sculpture., Latvian Postal Service will issue a stamp and an envelope dedicated to him. The new philatelic issue will be available from 16 October.

latvia.title: Man to be prosecuted for murder attempt against Latvian border guard
latvia.description: A Ukrainian citizen involved in a plot to kill a State Border Guard will stand trial, according to the Latgale District Prosecutor's Office.

latvia.title: Drive slower in Latvia as of Thursday
latvia.description: From Thursday, 15 October, the maximum permitted speed limit on roads in Latvia will be 90 kilometres per hour (km/h). The exception will be the Vidzeme motorway, Latvian State Roads (LVC) said.

latvia.title: Latvian men still have high suicide rate, women's rate much lower
latvia.description: Data published recently by Eurostat show that in the European Union in 2023, the standardised death rate for intentional self-harm was 10 per 100 000 inhabitants, with the rate for males 3.6 times as high as that for females.

latvia.title: Art auction to raise funds for families of those missing in Nepal
latvia.description: The Spice shopping entre in Rīga is hosting an exhibition "Over the Mountains - to My Family" from October 13th. It is described a gesture of goodwill from artists and a gift to the families of those who have disappeared in the tragic floods in Nepal.

latvia.title: Health sector needs more money; doctors point to low salaries and labour shortages
latvia.description: The health sector needs an additional 826 million euros next year, the Ministry of Health has estimated. Doctors say the needs are many and it is high time to solve systemic problems.

latvia.title: Reminder not to toss electronics in waste bin
latvia.description: An old mobile phone, an electric toothbrush, or a used e-cigarette, although these devices are small, can cause a fire during collection and sorting if they are thrown away with household waste. Even a small battery can cause major problems, so it is important to dispose of them correctly, Latvian Television issued a reminder on October 14.

latvia.title: PM Kulbergs says total Russian grain ban is not possible
latvia.description: It is currently not possible for Latvia to impose a planned 300% increase in railway infrastructure usage fees for Russian grain transit or to ban it altogether, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) stated on Tuesday after a government meeting.

latvia.title: 'Latvijas balzams' accounts frozen again
latvia.description: Following the closure of the legal protection proceedings against the drinks manufacturer ‘Amber Latvijas balzams’, the State Revenue Service (VID) has once again frozen the company’s accounts, according to a statement issued by the company to the ‘Nasdaq Riga’ stock exchange.

latvia.title: Kulbergs claims Latvia will have more power to deal with border threats
latvia.description: The services involved in protecting the state border will have greater powers to deal with attackers and threats, the government decided on Tuesday during a closed-door session, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) said in an interview with Latvian Television's Morning Panorama n October 14.

latvia.title: Scammers get creative with fake 'dinosaur festival' in Latvia
latvia.description: A fake medical data portal and a dinosaur world festival that isn’t actually taking place. Fraudsters are constantly devising new ways to trick people into believing their hoaxes and falling into their traps, Latvian Television reported on October 13.

latvia.title: Good news for winter swimmers in Rīga
latvia.description: Water quality tests carried out by Riga City Council show that at five bathing spots popular with winter swimmers – Bābelītis, Vakarbuļļi, Vecāķi, Lucavsala Bay and Ķīpsala – the microbiological indicators are good and swimming is permitted, the Rīga City Council said on October 13.

latvia.title: Latvia and Poland look to deepen cybersecurity cooperation

latvia.title: Radio neko nestāsta un “112” aplikācija uzkārusies: cilvēki ziņo, ka trauksmes gadījumā joprojām ir bardaks
latvia.description: Latvija šorīt piedzīvoja kārtējo iespējamo gaisa telpas apdraudējumu. lithuania.title: Renátó visszanézte a Házasság első látásrát: „Csak ámulok és bámulok, micsoda hazugsághálókra derült így utólag fény”
Lezárták Moszkva légterét, Trump kihátrált a kemény szankciók mögül – Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról szombaton
lithuania.description: Donald Trump egy pénteken kiadott rendeletével felfüggesztette az oroszellenes szankciós törvény kulcsfontosságú rendelkezéseit – köztük az orosz árukra kivetendő vámokat és az orosz olaj- és gázvásárlásokat büntető intézkedéseket –, mindössze néhány nappal a hatálybalépésük előtt. Ukrajna közben újraindította az orosz olajfinomítók elleni csapásokat: már hatodik egymást követő éjszaka korlátozták a légiforgalmat Moszkva felett, a fővárosi repülőtereken járatok százai torlódtak fel. A Fekete-tenger térségében kereskedelmi hajókat érnek dróncsapások, Nicușor Dan román elnök ezért a NATO nagyobb szerepvállalását kéri a térségben. A fronton az orosz vezérkar a Donyeck megyei erődváros, Dobropillja elfoglalásáról számolt be, Moszkva szerint pedig egyelőre nincs napirenden a béketárgyalások folytatása az amerikai küldöttséggel. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb fejleményeivel.

lithuania.title: Magyar Péter elárulta, mit kért tőle Zelenszkij a négyszemközti tárgyalásuk során
lithuania.description: Történelmi jelentőségűnek nevezte Magyar Péter miniszterelnök a kárpátaljai magyarok jogairól kötött megállapodást, miután négyszemközt tárgyalt Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnökkel. A kormányfő az RTL-nek adott interjújában jó kezdetnek nevezte a megállapodást, amely szerinte javíthatja a két ország kapcsolatát, ugyanakkor jelezte, hogy a következő hetekben figyelni fogják, teljesül-e a többi része is. Zelenszkij kérésére Magyar Péter azt mondta, nincs akadálya annak, hogy az ukrán kukoricát vonaton Magyarországon keresztül szállítsák Nyugat-Európába, amennyiben a szállítmányok csak áthaladnak az országon. Az ukrán elnök október 23-i budapesti látogatását nem tartja valószínűnek, bár az állami megemlékezésre több uniós vezető, köztük Emmanuel Macron francia elnök is érkezik.

lithuania.title: A folyamatos dróntámadások miatt a NATO segítségét kéri a román elnök
lithuania.description: Nicușor Dan román elnök a Fekete-tenger biztonságáról és a NATO szerepvállalásáról beszélt az euronewsnak adott interjújában, miközben kereskedelmi hajókat érnek dróncsapások Románia és Bulgária partjainál, a térség biztonsági helyzete pedig egyre feszültebbé válik.

lithuania.description: The plans include joint defence production, strengthening NATO's northern and eastern flanks, and continued support for Ukraine.

lithuania.title: Senátor ODS podpořil v Plzni sokyni z ANO. Skončilo to vítězstvím opozice a nejvyšší volební účastí
lithuania.description: Málokterý senátní souboj byl tak sledovaný jako ten v okrsku Plzeň-město. lithuania.title: AI jako výbušné i hravé téma. Byla jsem na londýnské premiéře filmu Artificial
lithuania.description: Davy, kam se podíváš. Stojí před londýnským kinem Royal Festival Hall. Čekají na tvůrce filmu Artificial. Natočil ho režisér Luca Guadagnino. lithuania.title: Reuniune a Consiliului NATO, programată la cererea României, după atacurile navelor la Marea Neagră și incursiunile dronelor rusești

lithuania.title: Drono sprogimo liudininkė Pasvalio rajone: „Visi stikliukai sudrebėjo, jausmas, lyg būtų žaibas“
lithuania.description: 15min iš įvykio vietos: Pasvalio rajone uždarytas kelias, skraidė sraigtasparnis ir naikintuvai, o prieš tai drebėjo stiklai. Viena įvykio liudininkė su 15min pasidalijo neišdildomais šio sekmadienio ryto įspūdžiais.

lithuania.title: Irano parlamentas patvirtino naują gynybos ministrą
lithuania.description: Irano įstatymų leidėjai sekmadienį šalies naujuoju gynybos ministru patvirtino Mehrdadą Akhlaghi.

lithuania.title: Premjeras: dėl sekmadienį įskridusio drono reikia ištirti sabotažo versiją
lithuania.description: Premjeras Mindaugas Sinkevičius teigia, kad dėl sekmadienio rytą į Lietuvą įskridusio drono reikia įvertinti sabotažo versiją.

lithuania.title: Rusijos hibridinio karo dalis: premjeras įvertino bandymą padegti Lietuvos įmonę, kurioje saugoma „Starlink“ ryšio įranga
lithuania.description: Sekmadienio po vidurnakčio bandyta padegti Lietuvos įmonę, kurioje saugoma „Starlink“ ryšio įranga, pranešė ministras pirmininkas Mindaugas Sinkevičius. Tarnybos šią įmonę buvo perspėjusios dėl galimų išpuolių, apsauga sustiprinta, pasikėsinimas nepavyko. Krašto apsaugos ministras Robertas Kaunas prasitarė, kad gaisras įmonės teritorijoje buvo kilęs, tačiau incidentas greitai suvaldytas.

lithuania.title: Rusija dronais ir raketa atakavo Ukrainą: smogta pramonei ir civilinei infrastruktūrai
lithuania.description: Rusija sekmadienį vėl atakavo Ukrainą, šiaurės vakariniuose Volynės bei Rivnės regionuose kilo gaisrų, pranešė pareigūnai.

lithuania.title: Radviliškyje bute mirė peiliu sužalotas vyras, įtariamasis uždarytas į areštinę
lithuania.description: Radviliškyje šeštadienio vakarą per konfliktą bute neblaivus vyras peiliu mirtinai sužalojo kitą vyrą, pranešė Policijos departamentas.

lithuania.title: Po Rusijos atakos prieš Ukrainą Lenkijoje ieškoma neatpažinto objekto
lithuania.description: Po Rusijos atakos prieš Ukrainą sekmadienį gauti pranešimai apie į Lenkijos oro erdvę įskridusį neatpažintą objektą, todėl rytinėje šalies dalyje policija vykdo paieškas, skelbia portalas „TVP World“.

lithuania.title: „15min“ žurnalistas drono pavojaus įkarštyje ieškojo priedangų ir norinčiųjų jose slėptis
lithuania.description: Sekmadienio rytą pasirodžius informacijai apie tai, kad į Panevėžio apskritį galimai įskrido dronas, „15min“ žurnalistas nusprendė patikrinti, ar gyventojai gali patekti į oficialiame priedangų žemėlapyje pažymėtas saugias vietas. Apskritai, ar žinia apie galimai į Panevėžio apskritį įskridusį droną ir dėl jo paskelbtas oro pavojus panevėžiečius bei rajono gyventojus sekmadienio rytą išjudino iš šiltų lovų ir paskatino skubėti ieškoti saugesnių vietų?
